description: This Java class provides utility methods for accessing the current EntityManager and its change set within a diagnostic/profile context of the Fineract application, primarily used for debugging and introspection of JPA persistence state.

classes.name: DiagnosticsEntityManager
classes.description: Utility class for accessing the current transactional EntityManager and associated change sets for debugging purposes.

methods.name: getCurrentEntityManager
methods.description: Retrieves the current transaction-bound EntityManager, cast to EclipseLink's EntityManagerImpl for introspection.

methods.name: getCurrentChanges
methods.description: Returns the current UnitOfWorkChangeSet, representing pending changes within the EntityManager.

methods.name: setApplicationContext
methods.description: Sets the Spring ApplicationContext, enabling static access to beans within this utility class.
